notes: Corrected: the supplied *hath* is not licensed by rule 41, which gives an articleless attributive its relative and any copula rule 20 supplies. Nothing in this clause makes it possessive and the participle keeps *superfluous*, so under rule 43's closing test *hath* and the object noun *anything* it requires are added together; the participle keeps the discontinuous *that ... superfluous*.
*in his parts* stays added: the Hebrew writes neither the preposition nor the dimension noun (rules 30, 33).
Each member of וְשׁוֹר וָשֶׂה has a connective of its own, so *Either* and *or* are taken separately and rule 14's correlative pair is not placed.
